verdict.rationale: Deel exposes a broad REST API (contracts, payroll, time-off) and an MCP server with tools mapping to API operations (contracts, time-off, EOR cost calculations), suggesting substantial UI-to-API parity, but no evidence explicitly claims or demonstrates full feature parity with the UI. Missing for 10: explicit parity documentation covering all UI workflows (e.g., invoicing, compliance docs, benefits admin), independent verification that all UI actions are API-accessible.
